keyFindings.description: Past its deadline, runner_wait has no bound when the runner pod can no longer be exec'd (OOM, eviction, activeDeadlineSeconds 43200, deleted): a failing runner_term retries every 15 s for ever, and after the SIGKILL the loop only polls .rc for ever. The step shell blocks, pg_disk_watch_stop never runs, and the heartbeat keeps the namespace lock alive. Round 8 ended the wait with status 1 there. The comment at 1700-1705 says RUNNER_STOP_GRACE_SECONDS bounds it.
A TERM between the stopped check and pg_disk_watch_trap's reinstall is held only until the next poll's act; one trap for the whole function (set stopped, kill the nap) removes the swap.
The guard ladder (0/1/2, then runner_term, then retry) is written three times and runner_term is safe only by convention; one runner_stop NAME [SIGNAL] that returns the answer.
